title: Buoy gauge outage tolerance
body:
# Buoy gauge outage tolerance

## Problem
The tide gauge on each buoy loses its satellite uplink for hours at a time. Readings taken during an outage must not be lost.

## Hardware
The gauge samples every 5 minutes. It reserves 8 KB of flash for readings, and each stored reading takes 64 bytes. The buffer design is recorded in `decision/gauge-buffer-is-sized-for-the-sampling-interval`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC1.** While the uplink is down, the gauge keeps every reading it takes for up to 6 hours. *Verified by: manual check.*
- **AC2.** When the uplink returns, buffered readings are sent oldest first. *Verified by: manual check.*

title: Gauge buffer is sized for the sampling interval
body:
# Gauge buffer is sized for the sampling interval

The sampling interval is ten minutes, so six hours of readings is 36 readings, and the gauge buffer is a ring of 36 slots. Once the ring is full the oldest reading is overwritten.
